record.paper_title: Conjectures and Open Questions on the Structure and Regularity of Spaces with Lower Ricci Curvature Bounds
record.original_question: Suppose a sequence of pointed n-dimensional Riemannian manifolds (M_i^n, g_i, p_i) converges in the Gromov–Hausdorff sense to a metric space (X, d, p), with Ric ≥ −(n − 1) and Vol(B_1(p_i)) > v > 0. Is it true that, outside a subset of codimension three in X, each point has a unique tangent cone?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.7. Let Mni, gi, pi → (X, d, p) satisfy Ric ≥ −(n − 1) and Vol(B1(pi)) > v > 0, then the tangent cones of X are unique away from a set of codimension three.

artifact.category_tag: tangent cones in Ricci limit spaces
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ be an integer and let $v > 0$. Consider a sequence of pointed complete $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds $(M_i^n, g_i, p_i)$ satisfying the uniform lower Ricci curvature bound $\mathrm{Ric}_{g_i} \geq -(n-1)\, g_i$ and the noncollapsing condition $\mathrm{Vol}(B_1(p_i)) > v$, and suppose that $(M_i^n, g_i, p_i)$ converges in the pointed Gromov–Hausdorff sense to a metric space $(X, d, p)$. For $x \in X$, a tangent cone at $x$ is any pointed Gromov–Hausdorff limit of a rescaled sequence $(X, r_j^{-1} d, x)$ with $r_j \to 0$; we say $X$ has a unique tangent cone at $x$ if all such limits are isometric (as pointed metric spaces). 

Prove or disprove: there exists a subset $S \subset X$ of Hausdorff codimension at least $3$ (i.e., $\dim_{\mathcal H}(X) - \dim_{\mathcal H}(S) \geq 3$) such that for every $x \in X \setminus S$, the tangent cone of $X$ at $x$ is unique.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is a known conjecture on uniqueness of tangent cones away from a codimension-three set in noncollapsed Ricci limit spaces. Related partial results exist (Colding–Naber Hölder continuity of tangent cones; Colding–Minicozzi uniqueness for Einstein manifolds under smooth cross-section assumptions; Cheeger–Jiang–Naber rectifiability of singular strata, with codimension-four structure for two-sided Ricci bounds), but no full proof of uniqueness of tangent cones outside a codimension-three set under only a lower Ricci bound has been found. The conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Rectifiability of Singular Sets in Lower and Bounded Ricci Curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Rectifiability of singular strata; tangent cones (n-4)-symmetric away from a set of (n-4)-measure zero, but uniqueness of tangent cones not established off a codimension-three set under only lower Ricci bound.
status_evidence.claim: Strong structural results known but full codimension-three tangent cone uniqueness conjecture not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Sharp Hölder continuity of tangent cones (Colding–Naber)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Hölder continuity of tangent cones along interior of minimizing geodesics under lower Ricci bound; partial progress toward uniqueness questions.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial progress relevant to the conjecture but does not establish uniqueness off a codimension-three set.

status_evidence.title: On uniqueness of tangent cones for Einstein manifolds (Colding–Minicozzi)
status_evidence.snippet: Uniqueness of tangent cones holds for Einstein manifolds when one tangent cone has smooth cross-section.
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness is known under additional assumptions, not in the generality of the conjecture.
